items.claim: Jeremiah has extreme explosiveness that allows him to close distance quickly and potentially finish opponents.
items.quote: he can close space so fast that you never even seen it coming

items.claim: Jeremiah excels at attacking the neck and utilizing submission threats like the ninja choke during wrestling exchanges.
items.quote: Jeremiah is really good with attacking the neck.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj possesses good takedowns, good submissions, and punching power on the feet.
items.quote: Ramiz has good takedowns, he has good submissions. Um he definitely has pop on the feet as well.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj is younger, faster, and more explosive than Neil Magny.
